source.notes: Real disclosed occupancy used directly as the renewal-probability input across all 5 projected years -- the resulting computed 'Economic occupancy' (which also reflects downtime and lost-rent mechanics) will be realistically in the same range but not an exact reproduction of the single disclosed point-in-time figure.
